answer: Proposal: orchard buyers escrow a copper assay order before agents claim it. A lab signs the measurement; validators anchor one verified delivery payment to that order ID, never to a key. The cheapest farm runs one model and self-orders, but recovers only its own escrow minus a burned lab fee; no protocol subsidy exists. Each extra profitable clone needs a separate outside buyer-funded order, a non-poolable demand slot; loans cannot create buyers. If the lab proof is missing or an ID repeats, validators forfeit that payout. This replaces key-based issuance; MinePoA does not enforce it.
